SELECT t.id AS taskId,t.name AS taskName,t.type,t.priority, t.plan_start_time,t.plan_end_time,t.description AS taskDescription, t.reality_start_time,t.reality_end_time,t.status AS taskState, t.create_time,t.phase_name,t.update_time,t.create_user_name,t.create_user_id, t.charge_id AS taskChargeId,t.charge_name AS taskChargeName, t.product_id,t.business_process_id,t.related_sku_type, pi.charge_name AS productChargeName,pi.charge_id AS productChargeId, pi.name AS productName,pj.charge_id AS projectChargeId,pj.charge_name AS projectChargeName, (CASE WHEN pttr.task_time is null THEN 0 else pttr.task_time end)/8 as realTaskTime FROM project_task t LEFT JOIN product_info pi ON pi.id=t.product_id LEFT JOIN project_info pj ON pj.product_id=pi.id LEFT JOIN project_task_time_record pttr on t.id = pttr.project_task_id WHERE t.id=#{taskId}
SELECT id,pid,phase_id,name,type,plan_start_time,plan_end_time,priority,status, charge_name,quote_sys_task_id,product_id,charge_id FROM project_task WHERE product_id=#{productId} AND pid !='0'
